text: Know Your Customer Basics. Financial institutions in Ghana must verify the identity of every customer. Doctor Mensah notes that two point five million accounts were reviewed in twenty twenty-four. The penalty for a breach can reach one thousand, two hundred and fifty cedis and fifty pesewas per day. Risk rating. Customers are rated low, medium or high risk. High-risk customers need enhanced due diligence, for example source-of-funds checks, before the account opens on the first of March twenty twenty-six. Onboarding steps.
